projects.title: Food Chain Magnate
projects.stack: react-ts-pixi (MVP UI built DOM+SVG board — recorded D4 fallback deviation; Pixi reserved)
projects.note: Splotter economic heavyweight; manual seed. Real-IP non-distributed prototype (WotR basis). BUILT M1->M8 in one pass; AWAITING BUILD GATE (playtest). Pure deterministic engine COMPLETE + tested: map/distance, Dinnertime resolution (incl. rulebook $125 example), pricing, payday, bank two-break end, full employee registry+training tree (mgmt edges, VP slots 2/3/4/5/10), org-chart capacity, working actions, job market, 7-phase machine, marketing footprints+demand, all 18 milestones, full-turn orchestrator, AI (tiers+personalities), campaign objectives/scenarios/medals. Playable UI vs AI (DOM+SVG board, menu/setup/shell/end, synth audio+mute). PASS 2: recruiting-discount salary rule; climbing AI ladder; front-of-house (Pause/Settings/Continue/Past-Games); Dinnertime step-through (engine trace + step UI). PASS 3: Campaign UI fully wired (12-scenario/4-era hub + medals + career dossier + briefing + live objectives + debrief + persistence, e2e). PASS 4: built the full Hard MULTI-TURN GAME-TREE SEARCH (src/ai/search.ts) — deterministic best-response plan search, Med opponent model, 2-turn rollouts via playTurn, leaf=cash advantage, move-ordering + iterative-deepening + node-budget (deterministic sim count) + branch-and-bound; candidate plans vary marketing product × targeting, status-quo always included so no regression; Low/Med untouched (one shared parameterized heuristic). Ladder now Hard>Low 100%, Med>Low 82%, Hard>Med 76% — clears the 65% target AND the 70%+ decisive ideal. New search budget+dominance test; balance floors raised to 0.90/0.70/0.70; flaky campaign e2e (random seed) fixed. VERIFIED: 67 vitest, npm run sim (100/76/82), 4 Playwright e2e, vite build clean (~211kB), tsc clean. REMAINING: per-card deck counts unsourceable (physical-only, flagged default). Artifacts: 01-06 specs/GDD/card-ref + concept/ + app/ + build-report.md. D1 LOCKED. No open decisions.
